tests.name: bson_array_skip_keys
tests.intent: Verify that parsing a BSON array successfully skips copying and validating element keys under default error handlers.

tests.name: bson_array_strict_utf8
tests.intent: Verify that strict error handler still inspects and validates array element names for UTF-8 correctness.

tests.name: bson_bulk_scan_various_lengths
tests.intent: Probe BSON cstr bulk scanning with keys of 1 to 17 bytes to test 8-byte word boundaries.

tests.name: bson_stream_input_array
tests.intent: Verify stream-based BSON parsing of arrays uses the non-contiguous fallback path correctly.

tests.name: bson_sax_parse_array
tests.intent: Probe BSON sax_parse on an array document to ensure keys are skipped without calling sax->key.

tests.name: bson_empty_string_key
tests.intent: Test BSON parsing with empty key strings.

tests.name: bson_nested_arrays_objects
tests.intent: Test deeply nested combinations of objects and arrays to verify stack handling and skipping.

tests.name: bson_long_key_bulk
tests.intent: Test BSON parsing with keys longer than 8 bytes using the bulk zero scanner.

tests.name: bson_ignore_error_handler
tests.intent: Verify that error_handler_t::ignore handles malformed strings without throwing during parsing.

tests.name: bson_replace_error_handler
tests.intent: Verify that error_handler_t::replace processes elements without crashing.

tests.name: bson_array_multiple_elements
tests.intent: Test BSON array with multiple elements ensuring sequence of indices like "0", "1", "2" are correctly skipped.

tests.name: bson_large_array_indices
tests.intent: Test BSON array with index names exceeding single-digit numbers to check multi-character numeric array keys.

tests.name: bson_strict_valid_array
tests.intent: Verify that strict error handler successfully parses valid array names without raising errors.

tests.name: bson_unterminated_string_bulk
tests.intent: Verify handling of bulk input without a C-string null terminator.

tests.name: bson_object_with_empty_key
tests.intent: Test object containing an element with an explicitly empty key string.

tests.name: bson_roundtrip_array
tests.intent: Perform a serialization and deserialization roundtrip on an array to ensure internal representations align.

tests.name: bson_array_with_various_types
tests.intent: Check BSON array containing elements of varied data types to verify correct index skipping.

tests.name: bson_empty_array
tests.intent: Parse an empty BSON array and verify output.

tests.name: bson_stream_strict_error
tests.intent: Verify stream input with strict error handling on malformed array indices throws correctly.

tests.name: bson_bulk_exact_eight_bytes
tests.intent: Test BSON key scanning with a key of exactly 8 bytes length to test block boundary conditions.

tests.name: bson_sax_parse_array_fixed
tests.intent: Probe BSON sax_parse on an array document to ensure keys are skipped without calling sax->key.

tests.name: bson_array_multiple_elements_fixed
tests.intent: Test BSON array with multiple elements ensuring sequence of indices like "0", "1", "2" are correctly skipped.

tests.name: bson_roundtrip_array_fixed
tests.intent: Perform a serialization and deserialization roundtrip on an array to ensure internal representations align.

tests.name: bson_sax_parse_array_fixed_fixed
tests.intent: Probe BSON sax_parse on an array document to ensure keys are skipped without calling sax->key.
